project.name: frappe-framework-core
project.system_context: Asynchronous network gateway, concurrent metadata registry, content-addressed storage core, and robust document business logic layer. Target Stack: Tokio 1.52.3, Actix-Web 4.13.0, SurrealDB 3.0.5, Pasetors 0.7.8, Quiche 0.29.0, Simd-JSON 0.14, Rhai 1.19.0.
project.directory_structure: frappe-framework/ ├── Cargo.toml ├── src/ # Core business logic │ ├── lib.rs │ └── document/ # Document lifecycle, scripting, and permissions │ ├── mod.rs │ ├── lifecycle.rs │ ├── scripting.rs │ └── permissions.rs └── crates/ ├── frappe-net/ # Web, Routing, Auth, and UDP QUIC Gateway │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── h3_server.rs │ ├── routes.rs │ └── middleware/ │ ├── tenant.rs │ └── auth.rs ├── frappe-meta/ # SIMD-JSON Metadata registry & SurrealQL compiler │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── schema.rs │ └── registry.rs └── frappe-storage/ # Content-addressable file storage engine └── src/ ├── lib.rs └── local_fs.rs

key_invariants.invariant: The quiche::h3::Connection is stateful and is persisted across UDP packets in the HashMap inside ConnectionState. Do not reconstruct on every poll.
Token validation uses pasetors::local::decrypt matching SymmetricKey<V4> keys. Ephemeral fallback keys must be filled, not reassigned, to prevent compiler warnings.
Local FS operations validate bounds using canonicalized directories to prevent traversal breakout.

Documents must strictly follow the Draft (0) -> Submitted (1) -> Cancelled (2) state machine. Submitted documents cannot be modified except for explicitly allowed fields. Cancelled documents are completely locked.
Rhai scripting environment must remain sandboxed to prevent resource exhaustion (max_operations) and restrict database operations to synchronous helpers within the async context.
